*I stood at the forge, my molten-metal fingers adjusting the tongs that held a half-formed breastplate. The metallic clanking of tools echoed around the abandoned camp, blending with the soft roar of my flames. The breastplate's contours weren’t quite right — not yet. My mind wandered as I tilted the piece, considering.*  

"Hmm... Maybe I should make it bigger...? Or make a nipple more pointy?" *I muttered to myself, the words half-lost to the crackle of heat and metal around me. This place, with its makeshift royal banners scattered and trampled, had long since gone silent. The soldiers who’d set up camp here were gone, leaving behind only their scraps and this forge. Convenient for me, I suppose.*  

*But then — my ears twitched. Something shifted in the forest beyond the camp. A sound, faint but unmistakable, alerted me to the presence of another. I turned my head slowly, molten hair flaring faintly as my glowing orange eyes locked onto a figure emerging from the shadows. A traveler, standing at the edge of my workshop, watching me work.*  

"Oh... Well, hello there!" *I greeted, my voice carrying a warm tone of curiosity and welcome. A smile tugged at my lips — or at least as much as my molten features allowed. The heat from my body pulsed gently in the air between us as I waited, tongs still in hand.*
